A leading organisation in the retail and consumer sector is seeking an ERP Transformation Consultant to play a pivotal role in a major SAP S/4HANA transformation programme based in Kuala Lumpur.

ERP TRANSFORMATION CONSULTANT

This is an exceptional opportunity for you to join at the very beginning of a high-impact initiative, working directly with the CIO to shape, mobilise, and deliver a business-critical transformation. The position offers the chance to influence strategic direction, establish robust governance frameworks, and drive meaningful change across both technology and business functions. You will be empowered to bring your consulting expertise to bear, operating with significant autonomy while collaborating closely with senior stakeholders and implementation partners. If you are looking for a hands-on role where your ability to create structure, foster alignment, and ensure successful delivery will be highly valued, this is the perfect environment for you. Flexible working opportunities and exposure to a complex, multi-functional environment make this an outstanding next step for experienced professionals who thrive on responsibility and impact.
• Be at the forefront of a transformative SAP S/4HANA programme, shaping its success from inception alongside executive leadership.
• Enjoy flexible working opportunities within a supportive team culture that values collaboration, knowledge sharing, and professional growth.
• Gain exposure to a diverse range of business functions in a complex retail environment, working with both internal teams and leading implementation partners.

What you'll do:

As an ERP Transformation Consultant based in Kuala Lumpur, you will immerse yourself in one of the most significant SAP S/4HANA initiatives in the region. Your day-to-day responsibilities will see you collaborating directly with executive leadership to set up robust governance structures while defining clear objectives for each phase of the programme. You will take ownership of developing detailed roadmaps that anticipate potential risks or gaps before they arise—ensuring seamless integration between business goals and technology solutions. By fostering strong relationships with both internal teams and external partners such as system integrators or implementation specialists—you will help maintain accountability across all parties involved. Your expertise in change management will be crucial as you guide business leaders through periods of transition; crafting tailored communication strategies that build awareness while supporting readiness at every level. Success in this role means not only delivering on project milestones but also nurturing a collaborative environment where everyone feels engaged in driving positive outcomes.
• Partner closely with the CIO to design and implement governance structures, delivery models, and operating frameworks for the SAP S/4HANA transformation.
• Define clear programme objectives, scope, workstreams, milestones, dependencies, and key deliverables to ensure all aspects of the transformation are aligned.

• Develop and maintain an integrated transformation roadmap and comprehensive programme plan that addresses risks, dependencies, and gaps proactively.

• Oversee timelines, risks, issues, dependencies, and deliverables to ensure momentum is maintained throughout the transformation lifecycle.
• Support partner selection processes as well as ongoing governance and performance management of external vendors.
• Ensure continuous alignment between business requirements, technology delivery efforts, and overall transformation objectives through regular stakeholder engagement.
• Establish change management strategies that assess organisational impacts, develop communication plans, coordinate training needs, facilitate adoption activities, and address resistance effectively.

To excel as an ERP Transformation Consultant in this role you will bring substantial hands-on experience from previous SAP S/4HANA projects—ideally within retail or similarly complex sectors. Your background should include time spent in consulting environments where your ability to introduce structure made a tangible difference; whether through designing new governance models or facilitating critical decision-making sessions among senior leaders. Your interpersonal skills enable you to build trust quickly—fostering open communication channels that support smooth project delivery even under tight deadlines. Familiarity with industry-standard methodologies such as PMP or PRINCE2 is advantageous but not essential if you can demonstrate equivalent practical expertise. Above all else: your approachability combined with commercial awareness ensures that every recommendation you make aligns closely with broader organisational objectives.
